title: build save with no terminal and no --confirm shows the file, prints the token on stderr, exits 2 and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and B3-18/B3-19 (a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK: a terminal, or the token of the content he read; the guard denies the agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `jitso build save <id>` shows the build it would write (the draft bytes with `status: approved`) on stdout, every line prefixed with `+ `. Standard input is not a terminal here, and the runner never gives one, so with no `--confirm` it refuses: `JITSO REJECTED: saving a build needs the owner: run "jitso build save <id>" in a terminal, or "jitso build save <id> --confirm <token>" after reading the file above`, exit 2, where the token is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the bytes it would write. Nothing is written and the draft is kept. The oracle has no `build save` (the runner maps only `build list`): it answers `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs the `+ ` lines, the token text or the written file FAILS on it.
